text: Behind the booth, Samejima was waiting for me like usual.

name: Maneki
text: Sorry, no time for small talk. Tell me how to get the jackpot.

name: Samejima
text: Ooh! You’re interested in that, now?

name: Maneki
text: Um, but, how do I put this…? It’s a little hard for me to continue, as things are.

name: Maneki
text: I think I– I just really [b]need[/b] that jackpot. So if you have any advice, or–

name: Maneki
text: Actually, I think I’d better go ahead and go home.
A sharp, new light rippled through his eyes, like an LED pulsing along the rim of a machine.
Shaking his head, Samejima pulled himself together and drew out those flashy fangs in a strained sort of grin.

name: Samejima
text: Never quit while you’re ahead. I can help you out of this little bind you’re in.

name: Samejima
text: Here’s what we’ll do. Something a little… underneath the coral reef, yeah?

name: Samejima
text: You can play using some of my own money. Just bring it back once you’re done. Good manners and all– with a generous tip for me, of course.
